dedupe_keys.name: wdsresilience han and fos epanet test cases

description: The WDSResilience repository accompanies a study comparing water-network reliability surrogate measures under equal-cost and consistency perspectives. Its public tree contains four EPANET INP files named for HAN and FOS cases, split into two calculation folders, plus radar and stress-curve figures. The README names the study but gives no hydraulic table, model version, geographic provenance, scenario settings or time resolution. Consequently the safe reuse claim is limited to the published INP test cases and their figures, not to reproduced paper metrics. GitHub identifies an MIT licence, so the repository code and accompanying files are publicly available without a stated charge, subject to checking the licence scope of any source network. Coverage is two named benchmark networks with alternative setup files; neither is established here as an observed utility. A modeller could load the INP files into EPANET and inspect resilience-measure sensitivity, but their contents and numerical outputs were not opened or run. The collection complements data-uky-water-distribution-system-research-database as a narrow publication-specific configuration.
licence: MIT repository licence; rights of any original benchmark inputs were not separately documented.
